Civil Service Career — IRS

Thirty-five years in the Indian Revenue Service, rising to the Government of India's most senior administrative ranks.

🏢

35 Years in the Indian Revenue Service

Retired on 31st March 2025 as Principal Director General (Secretary-level), NACIN, CBIC — with All-India jurisdiction.

💼

Key Charges Held

Commissioner of Customs (North Eastern Region, Shillong), Central GST Commissioner (Manipur State), Commissioner (Audit) Guwahati, and Additional Commissioner (Service Tax) Kolkata.

💰

Central Deputation

Deputy Managing Director, NCDC New Delhi, and Financial Advisor, NEC (DoNER Ministry, Joint Secretary-level) — over 10 years' experience in development finance.

Beyond Borders

International Exposure

Representing India on the global stage — from customs diplomacy to regional trade and connectivity negotiations.

🌐

Represented India/CBIC at WCO conferences in Bangkok and Brussels; led Indian delegations for India-China-Myanmar (UNODC) and Indo-Bangladesh Customs talks.

🛣

World Bank Study Group member on regional trade & logistics (South East Asia and Europe); team member for the India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway negotiations.

🎓

Government of India Fellow, Humphrey School of Public Affairs, University of Minnesota, USA; trained at Wageningen University (Netherlands) and Royal Academy of Customs, Malaysia.

Beyond Office

Public & Community Engagement

  • President, IRS Association (CIT), North East Chapter — two terms.
  • Active in student and community welfare initiatives; authored papers on Indo-Myanmar Border Trade and regional connectivity.

The Road Ahead

Vision for Tamenglong

Building on decades of public service experience to bring real, lasting change to Tamenglong District.

🎓

Education

Strengthening educational infrastructure across Tamenglong so students can compete anywhere in India.

  • A dedicated Competitive Exam Centre for SSC, Banking, CUET, and other national-level exams
  • A B.Ed College to train future teachers
  • A D.El.Ed College to build a strong foundation in elementary education
  • A fully functioning Science College to open new academic pathways
💼

Employment & Entrepreneurship for Youth

Creating real employment and entrepreneurship opportunities for the unemployed youth of Tamenglong — empowering job aspirants and college graduates to build their futures without leaving home.

❤️

Healthcare

Improving healthcare infrastructure and access to quality medical care across every village in the constituency.

🛣

Connectivity

Better roads, digital connectivity, and infrastructure linking Tamenglong to the rest of Manipur and the region — drawing on his experience in cross-border trade and highway negotiations.

🤝

Tribal Welfare

Protecting and promoting the rights, culture, and economic development of the tribal communities of Tamenglong.

"Young people, job aspirants, college students, and unemployed youth deserve a leader committed to fulfilling these needs and building a better future for the next generation."
